name: Saundatti
text: the revenue and police offices of the Parasgad sub-division Saundatti has a municipality, dispensary, sub-judge’s court, post office, a collector’s bungalow, two schools four old temples and a ruined fort. The municipality, which was established in 1876, had in 1882-83 an income of £269 (Rs. 2690) and an expenditure of £505 (Rs. 5050).
